name: 해방된 할파스
prompt:
Character: 해방된 할파스 (Liberated Halpas). The attached original is the sole visual identity authority.

Create NEW high-detail isometric RPG game animation source art from the attached EXISTING character reference. Reproduce that EXACT character identity, anatomy, silhouette, armor, face/head shape, colors and equipment, including every distinctive wing, horn, crest and weapon shown. Do not replace it with a generic dragon, generic demon, knight, or another species. Preserve the reference's correct body plan, not a name-based guess. New hand-authored poses; do not paste the reference portrait, mirror it, warp it, shift it, or duplicate any pose.

OUTPUT: one transparent RGBA sprite sheet, PORTRAIT 2:3 aspect, high resolution. EXACTLY 2 columns and 6 rows of separate full-body characters = 12 poses, temporal order left to right then down. Every character is the SAME size/model, same view/camera/lighting, all facing true EAST / screen RIGHT. Use fixed camera and uniform scale; show the rightward profile/three-quarter side consistent with the attached original. Body orientation, head/eyes, knees, feet and attack-facing must ALL point right throughout. Clear wide gutters; at least 24 pixels transparent between all silhouettes. No overlap between adjacent cells, no clipping, all wings/horns/weapons/tail/feet completely visible. No text, labels, borders, checkerboard artwork, scenery, detached effects or cast shadows. Each pose is ONE connected coherent character; every weapon/wing stays attached to hand/body. No unrelated extra bodies or decoration. Keep the dark outlines, local shading, material detail and specific reference palette readable at native sprite size.

POSES 0–5 (first three rows): six physically distinct phases of a real alternating locomotion cycle appropriate to the original body. 0 near leg/wing contact A, 1 weight-bearing compression A, 2 opposing limb passing/lift, 3 far leg/wing contact B, 4 weight-bearing compression B, 5 return passing. Left and right supporting limbs must genuinely alternate; pelvis, shoulders and carried equipment respond coherently. Feet do not skate. If this reference is airborne, keep its genuine airborne anatomy and produce articulated wing propulsion and opposing limb response instead of inventing walking legs.
POSES 6–11 (last three rows): SIX SEPARATELY DRAWN dedicated faster RUN / accelerated flight phases. These must have different poses from the walk phases: longer extension, deeper compression, clear airborne/recovery interval, greater articulated propulsion and coherent opposite arm/leg or wing motion. They are not duplicates, shifts or faster playback of the walk cycle. Maintain exact identity and body proportions in all12 full figures.

The sheet is production source art for a Godot eight-direction actor; this request is ONLY its EAST locomotion pilot. Do not add other directions or idle/attack/death poses. Precision of the12 requested anatomical poses and faithful identity matters more than a poster composition.
